reason: Use A's compact single form overall: time with a concrete format example, city lookup followed by a selected-place summary, and one calculate/save action. Replace the form with the result, saved confirmation, Done, Edit and Forget after success. It gives the clearest correction at 200% and the shortest coherent completion sequence. B's large step headings undermine its space-saving benefit; C adds review machinery that this two-field task does not need. A still needs a clear city-selection prerequisite and demonstrated runtime behavior. No variant meets the authorized threshold across every screen and component.
limitations: Independent assessment used only the six attached sheets and the supplied behavior descriptions. No files, prior ratings, other graders or implementation were consulted.

Each state score considers normal and 200% views together. Averages shown in findings use the frozen formula. Component vectors use the same six-dimension order as screen dimensions; null denotes an inapplicable or undemonstrated component response, not a passing score.

Prototype feedback scores assess visible guidance, errors and confirmation only. Actual lookup, validation, calculation, saving, recovery, focus management, announcements and motion behavior remain unverified; fixture results do not demonstrate success.

Shared component scores: baseline tabs [7,7,8,8,8,7]; baseline central orb [5,7,8,6,null,6]; A/B/C tabs [7,7,8,6,5,6]; A/B/C header/Close [8,8,8,8,null,7]. The baseline visibly marks You selected; alternatives lack an equally clear selected-tab treatment. Their mixed icon styles also weaken coherence.

Offscreen actions are recorded as scrolling and hierarchy costs, not automatically declared unreachable. Screenshots cannot establish scroll reachability, keyboard obstruction, focus order, target dimensions or screen-reader semantics.

Baseline browser checks are supplied evidence, not independently rerun here. Zero axe findings and successful persistence checks do not erase generic validation, displaced results or stale post-forgetting success text.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver and native behavior remain unverified separately. Browser-facing visual dimensions can earn 9 provisionally, but these scores do not certify full/native 9–10 performance.
